sentences.zh: 淮南道淮南道，蓋古揚州之域，漢九江、廬江、江夏等郡，廣陵、六安國及南陽、汝南、臨淮之境。

translations.literal: The Huainan Circuit—Huainan Circuit—comprised broadly the ancient Yangzhou region: in Han times the commanderies of Jiujiang, Lujiang, Jiangxia, and others, together with Guangling, the kingdom of Liu'an, and the territories of Nanyang, Runan, and Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: The Huainan Circuit covered the ancient Yangzhou region—in Han times the commanderies of Jiujiang, Lujiang, Jiangxia, and the like, along with Guangling, the kingdom of Liu'an, and portions of Nanyang, Runan, and Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 揚、楚、滁、和、廬、壽、舒為星紀分，安、黃、申、光、蘄為鶉尾分。

translations.literal: Yang, Chu, Chu, He, Lu, Shou, and Shu belonged to the Xingji astrological allotment; An, Huang, Shen, Guang, and Qi belonged to the Quewei allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Yang, Chu, Chuzhou, He, Lu, Shou, and Shu fell within the Xingji division; An, Huang, Shen, Guang, and Qi within the Quewei division.

translations.literal: There were twelve prefectures and fifty-three counties.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised twelve prefectures and fifty-three counties.

sentences.zh: 其名山：灊、天柱、羅、塗、八公。

translations.literal: Its famous mountains: Qian, Tianzhu, Luo, Tu, and Bagong.
translations.idiomatic: Its notable mountains were Mount Qian, Mount Tianzhu, Mount Luo, Mount Tu, and Mount Bagong.

translations.literal: Its great rivers: Chu, Fei, and Lake Chaohu.
translations.idiomatic: Its principal waterways were the Chu River, the Fei River, and Lake Chaohu.

translations.literal: Its tax levies: zhi silk, silk gauze, cotton, and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Its assessed tribute in kind included zhi silk, silk gauze, cotton, and cloth.

translations.literal: Its presented tribute: silk, cloth, ramie, and kudzu fiber.
translations.idiomatic: Its court tribute comprised silk, cloth, ramie, and kudzu cloth.

sentences.zh: 揚州揚州廣陵郡，大都督府。

translations.literal: Yangzhou—Yangzhou: Guangling commandery, great-protectorate prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Prefecture (Guangling commandery), a great-protectorate prefecture.

sentences.zh: 本南兗州江都郡，武德七年曰邗州，以邗溝為名，九年更置揚州，天寶元年|742年更郡名。

translations.literal: Originally the Jiangdu commandery of southern Yan Prefecture; in the seventh year of Wude it was called Han Prefecture, named for the Han Canal; in the ninth year Yangzhou was re-established; in the first year of Tianbao (742) the commandery name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Jiangdu commandery under southern Yan Prefecture. In Wude 7 it was renamed Han Prefecture after the Han Canal; in year 9 Yangzhou was restored; in Tianbao 1 (742) the commandery designation was revised.

sentences.zh: 土貢：金、銀、銅器、青銅鏡、綿、蕃客袍錦、被錦、半臂錦、獨窠綾、殿額莞席、水兕甲、黃稑米、烏節米、魚臍、魚鮬、糖蟹、蜜薑、藕、鐵精、空青、白芒、兔絲、蛇粟、括蔞粉。

translations.literal: Local tribute: gold, silver, bronze vessels, bronze mirrors, cotton, foreign-guest robe brocades, quilt brocades, half-sleeve brocades, single-nest damask, hall-eave rush mats, water-rhinoceros hide armor, yellow glutinous rice, black-joint rice, fish milt, fish paste, sugar-preserved crabs, honeyed ginger, lotus root, refined iron, azurite, white cogongrass, dodder seed, snake millet, and kudzu starch powder.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included gold, silver, bronze ware, bronze mirrors, cotton, brocades for foreign merchants' robes and quilts, half-sleeve brocades, single-pattern damask, hall-eave rush mats, water-rhinoceros hide armor, yellow glutinous rice, black-joint rice, fish milt and paste, sugar-preserved crabs, honeyed ginger, lotus root, refined iron, azurite, white cogongrass, dodder seed, snake millet, and kudzu starch.

sentences.zh: 有丹楊監、廣陵監錢官二。

translations.literal: There were two mint superintendencies: Danyang and Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: It had two coin-mint superintendencies, at Danyang and Guangling.

sentences.zh: 戶七萬七千一百五，口四十六萬七千八百五十七。

translations.literal: Households: seventy-seven thousand one hundred five; persons: four hundred sixty-seven thousand eight hundred fifty-seven.
Seven counties.

sentences.zh: 有府四，曰江平、新林、方山、邗江。

translations.literal: There were four military prefectures, called Jiangping, Xinlin, Fangshan, and Hanjiang.
translations.idiomatic: It had four military prefectures: Jiangping, Xinlin, Fangshan, and Hanjiang.

sentences.zh: 江都，江陽，六合，海陵，高郵，上。

translations.literal: Jiangdu, Jiangyang, Liuhe, Hailing, Gaoyou—upper grade.
translations.idiomatic: The counties were Jiangdu, Jiangyang, Liuhe, Hailing, and Gaoyou, all upper grade.

sentences.zh: 有隄塘，溉田數千頃，元和中，節度使李吉甫築。

translations.literal: There is an embankment irrigating fields of several thousand qing; in the Yuanhe era the military governor Li Jifu built it.
translations.idiomatic: An embankment there irrigates several thousand qing of fields; the military governor Li Jifu built it in the Yuanhe period.

translations.literal: Yangzi, Tianchang.
Chu Prefecture—Chu Prefecture: Huaiyin commandery, dense-ranked.

sentences.zh: 本江都郡之山陽、安宜縣地，臧君相據之，號東楚州。

translations.literal: Originally the territory of Shanyang and Anyi counties in Jiangdu commandery; Zang Junxiang held it and styled it Eastern Chu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Originally the lands of Shanyang and Anyi in Jiangdu commandery; Zang Junxiang seized them and called the seat Eastern Chu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 武德四年，君相降，因之，八年更名。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Junxiang surrendered and it was so established; in the eighth year it was renamed.
translations.idiomatic: In Wude 4 Junxiang submitted and the prefecture was established accordingly; in year 8 it received its present name.

translations.literal: Local tribute: coarse cloth and ramie cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included coarse cloth and ramie cloth.

sentences.zh: 戶二萬六千六十二，口十五萬三千。

translations.literal: Households: twenty-six thousand sixty-two; persons: one hundred fifty-three thousand.
Four counties.
Shanyang—upper grade.

sentences.zh: 有常豐堰，大曆中，黜陟使李承置以溉田。

translations.literal: There is the Changfeng weir; in the Dali era the promotion-and-demotion commissioner Li Cheng established it to irrigate fields.
translations.idiomatic: The Changfeng weir was installed in the Dali period by the promotion-and-demotion commissioner Li Cheng to irrigate farmland.

translations.literal: Yancheng, Baoying, Huaiyin.
Chu Prefecture—Chu Prefecture: Yongyang commandery, upper grade.
In the third year of Wude it was established by partitioning Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Wude 3 by splitting off territory from Yang Prefecture.

translations.literal: Local tribute: coarse cloth, silk cloth, ramie, thin silk, and hemp.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included coarse cloth, silk cloth, ramie, thin silk, and hemp.

translations.literal: There are two copper pits.

sentences.zh: 戶二萬六千四百八十六，口十五萬二千三百七十四。

translations.literal: Households: twenty-six thousand four hundred eighty-six; persons: one hundred fifty-two thousand three hundred seventy-four.
Three counties.
Qingliu—upper grade.
Quanjiao—dense-ranked.
Yongyang.
He Prefecture—He Prefecture: Liyang commandery, upper grade.
Local tribute: ramie cloth.

sentences.zh: 戶二萬四千七百九十四，口十二萬二千一十三。

translations.literal: Households: twenty-four thousand seven hundred ninety-four; persons: one hundred twenty-two thousand thirteen.
Three counties.
There is one military prefecture, called Xinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: It had one military prefecture, Xinchuan.

translations.literal: Liyang—upper grade.

sentences.zh: 有禱應山，本白石山，有棲隱山，本梅山，皆天寶六載更名。

translations.literal: There is Mount Daoying, originally Mount Baishi; there is Mount Qiyin, originally Mount Mei—both were renamed in the sixth year of Tianbao.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Daoying, formerly Mount Baishi, and Mount Qiyin, formerly Mount Mei, were both renamed in Tianbao 6.

translations.literal: Wujiang, Hanshan.

sentences.zh: 壽州壽州壽春郡，中都督府。

translations.literal: Shou Prefecture—Shou Prefecture: Shouchun commandery, middle great-protectorate prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shou Prefecture (Shouchun commandery), a middle great-protectorate prefecture.

sentences.zh: 本淮南郡，天寶元年更名。

translations.literal: Originally Huainan commandery; in the first year of Tianbao the name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Huainan commandery; renamed in Tianbao 1.

translations.literal: Local tribute: silk cloth, zhi silk, tea, and fresh dendrobium.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included silk cloth, zhi silk, tea, and fresh dendrobium.

sentences.zh: 戶三萬五千五百八十一，口十八萬七千五百八十七。

translations.literal: Households: thirty-five thousand five hundred eighty-one; persons: one hundred eighty-seven thousand five hundred eighty-seven.
Five counties.
Shouchun—upper grade.
There is Mount Bagong.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Bagong lies within the prefecture.

translations.literal: Anfeng, Shengtang, Huoqiu, Huoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Anfeng, Shengtang, Huoqiu, and Huoshan counties.

translations.literal: Upper grade.
At the beginning of Tianbao it was separately established by partitioning off Shengtang.
translations.idiomatic: In early Tianbao it was split off from Shengtang and established separately.

translations.literal: There are Mount Dabie and Mount Huo.
translations.idiomatic: It contains Mount Dabie and Mount Huo.

translations.literal: Lu Prefecture—Lu Prefecture: Lujiang commandery, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 土貢：花紗、交梭絲布、茶、蠟、酥、鹿脯、生石斛。

translations.literal: Local tribute: patterned gauze, crossed-shuttle silk cloth, tea, wax, butter, venison jerky, and fresh dendrobium.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included patterned gauze, crossed-shuttle silk cloth, tea, wax, butter, venison jerky, and fresh dendrobium.

sentences.zh: 戶四萬三千三百二十三，口二十萬五千三百九十六。

translations.literal: Households: forty-three thousand three hundred twenty-three; persons: two hundred five thousand three hundred ninety-six.
Five counties.
Hefei—dense-ranked.
Shen—dense-ranked.
Chao, Lujiang—dense-ranked.
There are Mount Ru and Mount Baimao.
translations.idiomatic: It has Mount Ru and Mount Baimao.

translations.literal: There is copper.
Shucheng.
Shu Prefecture—Shu Prefecture: Tong'an commandery, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 至德二載更名盛唐郡，後復故名。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhide it was renamed Shengtang commandery; later the original name was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Renamed Shengtang commandery in Zhide 2, then restored to its former name.

sentences.zh: 土貢：紵布、酒器、鐵器、石斛、蠟。

translations.literal: Local tribute: ramie cloth, wine vessels, ironware, dendrobium, and wax.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included ramie cloth, wine vessels, ironware, dendrobium, and wax.

sentences.zh: 戶三萬五千三百五十三，口十八萬六千三百九十八。

translations.literal: Households: thirty-five thousand three hundred fifty-three; persons: one hundred eighty-six thousand three hundred ninety-eight.
Five counties.

sentences.zh: 懷寧，宿松，望江，太湖，桐城。

translations.literal: Huaining, Susong, Wangjiang, Taihu, Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Huaining, Susong, Wangjiang, Taihu, and Tongcheng counties.

translations.literal: Guang Prefecture—Guang Prefecture: Yiyang commandery, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 本治光山，太極元年徙治定城。

translations.literal: Originally administered from Guangshan; in the first year of Taiji the seat was moved to Dingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: The seat was originally at Guangshan; in Taiji 1 it was moved to Dingcheng.

translations.literal: Local tribute: kudzu cloth and dendrobium.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included kudzu cloth and dendrobium.

sentences.zh: 戶三萬一千四百七十三，口十九萬八千五百八十。

translations.literal: Households: thirty-one thousand four hundred seventy-three; persons: one hundred ninety-eight thousand five hundred eighty.
Five counties.

sentences.zh: 定城，光山，仙居，殷城，固始。

translations.literal: Dingcheng, Guangshan, Xianju, Yincheng, Gushi.
translations.idiomatic: Dingcheng, Guangshan, Xianju, Yincheng, and Gushi counties.

translations.literal: Upper grade.
Qi Prefecture—Qi Prefecture: Qichun commandery, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 土貢：白紵，簟，鹿毛筆，茶，白花蛇、烏蛇脯。

translations.literal: Local tribute: white ramie, rush mats, deer-hair brushes, tea, and preserved white-flowered and black snakes.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included white ramie, rush mats, deer-hair brushes, tea, and preserved white-flowered and black snake meat.

sentences.zh: 戶二萬六千八百九，口十八萬六千八百四十九。

translations.literal: Households: twenty-six thousand eight hundred nine; persons: one hundred eighty-six thousand eight hundred forty-nine.
Four counties.
Qichun, Huangmei, Guangji, Qishui.
translations.idiomatic: Qichun, Huangmei, Guangji, and Qishui counties.

sentences.zh: 安州安州安陸郡，中都督府。

translations.literal: An Prefecture—An Prefecture: Anlu commandery, middle great-protectorate prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An Prefecture (Anlu commandery), a middle great-protectorate prefecture.

translations.literal: Local tribute: blue-green ramie cloth and pickled bamboo-shoot melons.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included blue-green ramie cloth and pickled bamboo-shoot melons.

sentences.zh: 戶二萬二千二百二十一，口十七萬一千二百二。

translations.literal: Households: twenty-two thousand two hundred twenty-one; persons: one hundred seventy-one thousand two hundred two.
Six counties.
There is one military prefecture, called Yi'an.
translations.idiomatic: It had one military prefecture, Yi'an.

translations.literal: Anlu.
Upper grade.
Yunmeng—middle grade.
There is Mount Shen.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Shen lies within the county.

translations.literal: Xiaochang, Yingcheng, Jiyang, Yingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaochang, Yingcheng, Jiyang, and Yingshan counties.

translations.literal: Huang Prefecture—Huang Prefecture: Qi'an commandery, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 本永安郡，天寶元年更名。

translations.literal: Originally Yong'an commandery; in the first year of Tianbao the name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Yong'an commandery; renamed in Tianbao 1.

sentences.zh: 土貢：白紵布、貲布、連翹、松蘿、蝱蟲。

translations.literal: Local tribute: white ramie cloth, coarse cloth, forsythia, usnea lichen, and gadfly larvae.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included white ramie cloth, coarse cloth, forsythia, usnea lichen, and gadfly larvae.

sentences.zh: 戶萬五千五百一十二，口九萬六千三百六十八。

translations.literal: Households: fifteen thousand five hundred twelve; persons: ninety-six thousand three hundred sixty-eight.
Three counties.
Huanggang, Huangpi, Macheng.
Shen Prefecture—Shen Prefecture: Yiyang commandery, middle grade.

sentences.zh: 土貢：緋葛、紵布、貲布、茶、蝱蟲。

translations.literal: Local tribute: crimson kudzu, ramie cloth, coarse cloth, tea, and gadfly larvae.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included crimson kudzu cloth, ramie cloth, coarse cloth, tea, and gadfly larvae.

sentences.zh: 戶二萬五千八百六十四，口十四萬七千七百五十六。

translations.literal: Households: twenty-five thousand eight hundred sixty-four; persons: one hundred forty-seven thousand seven hundred fifty-six.
Three counties.
Yiyang—upper grade.
To the south is the old Pingjing Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The old Pingjing Pass lies to the south.

translations.literal: Zhongshan.
Upper grade.
Luoshan.
To the right: the Huainan investigation commissioner, administering from Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the right: the Huainan investigation commissioner, with his seat at Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 江南道江南道，蓋古揚州南境，漢丹楊、會稽、豫章、廬江、零陵、桂陽等郡，長沙國及牂柯、江夏、南郡地。

translations.literal: The Jiangnan Circuit—Jiangnan Circuit—comprised broadly the southern borderlands of ancient Yangzhou: in Han times the commanderies of Danyang, Kuaiji, Yuzhang, Lujiang, Lingling, Guiyang, and others, the kingdom of Changsha, and the territories of Zangke, Jiangxia, and Nan commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan Circuit covered the southern reaches of ancient Yangzhou—in Han times the commanderies of Danyang, Kuaiji, Yuzhang, Lujiang, Lingling, Guiyang, and the like, the kingdom of Changsha, and lands of Zangke, Jiangxia, and Nan commanderies.

sentences.zh: 潤、昇、常、蘇、湖、杭、睦、越、明、衢、處、婺、溫、台、宣、歙、池、洪、江、饒、虔、吉、袁、信、撫、福、建、泉、汀、漳為星紀分，岳、鄂、潭、衡、永、道、郴、邵、黔、辰、錦、施、敍、奬、夷、播、思、費、南、溪、溱為鶉尾分。

translations.literal: Run, Sheng, Chang, Su, Hu, Hang, Mu, Yue, Ming, Qu, Chu, Wu, Wen, Tai, Xuan, She, Chi, Hong, Jiang, Rao, Qian, Ji, Yuan, Xin, Fu, Fu, Jian, Quan, Ting, and Zhang belonged to the Xingji allotment; Yue, E, Tan, Heng, Yong, Dao, Chen, Shao, Qian, Chen, Jin, Shi, Xu, Jiang, Yi, Bo, Si, Fei, Nan, Xi, and Zhen belonged to the Quewei allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Run, Sheng, Chang, Su, Hu, Hang, Mu, Yue, Ming, Qu, Chu, Wu, Wen, Tai, Xuan, She, Chi, Hong, Jiang, Rao, Qian, Ji, Yuan, Xin, Fu, Fujian, Jian, Quan, Ting, and Zhang fell within the Xingji division; Yue, E, Tan, Heng, Yong, Dao, Chen, Shao, Qian, Chen, Jin, Shi, Xu, Jiang, Yi, Bo, Si, Fei, Nan, Xi, and Zhen within Quewei.

sentences.zh: 為州五十一，縣二百四十七。

translations.literal: There were fifty-one prefectures and two hundred forty-seven counties.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised fifty-one prefectures and two hundred forty-seven counties.

sentences.zh: 其名山：衡、廬、茅、蔣、天目、天台、會稽、四明、括蒼、縉雲、金華、大庾、武夷。

translations.literal: Its famous mountains: Heng, Lu, Mao, Jiang, Tianmu, Tiantai, Kuaiji, Siming, Kuocang, Jinyun, Jinhua, Dayu, and Wuyi.
translations.idiomatic: Its notable mountains included Mount Heng, Mount Lu, Mount Mao, Mount Jiang, Mount Tianmu, Mount Tiantai, Mount Kuaiji, Mount Siming, Mount Kuocang, Mount Jinyun, Mount Jinhua, Mount Dayu, and Mount Wuyi.

sentences.zh: 其大川：湘、灨、沅、澧、浙江、洞庭、彭蠡、太湖。

translations.literal: Its great rivers: the Xiang, Gan, Yuan, Li, Zhe River, Dongting Lake, Poyang Lake, and Taihu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Its principal waterways were the Xiang, Gan, Yuan, and Li rivers, the Zhe River, and Lakes Dongting, Poyang, and Taihu.

translations.literal: Its tax levies: hemp and ramie.
translations.idiomatic: Its assessed tribute in kind included hemp and ramie.

sentences.zh: 厥貢：金、銀、紗、綾、蕉、葛、綿、綀、鮫革、藤紙、丹沙。

translations.literal: Its presented tribute: gold, silver, gauze, damask, plantain fiber, kudzu, cotton, thin silk, sharkskin, rattan paper, and cinnabar.
translations.idiomatic: Its court tribute comprised gold, silver, gauze, damask, plantain fiber, kudzu cloth, cotton, thin silk, sharkskin, rattan paper, and cinnabar.

sentences.zh: 江南東道潤州潤州丹楊郡，望。

translations.literal: Jiangnan East Circuit—Run Prefecture—Run Prefecture: Danyang commandery, illustrious grade.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan East Circuit — Run Prefecture, Danyang commandery, illustrious grade.

sentences.zh: 武德三年以江都郡之延陵縣地置，取潤浦為州名。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wude it was established from the territory of Yanling County in Jiangdu commandery, taking the Run Ford as the prefecture name.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Wude 3 from Yanling County in Jiangdu commandery and named for the Run Ford.

sentences.zh: 土貢：衫羅，水紋、方紋、魚口、繡葉、花紋等綾，火麻布，竹根、黃粟，伏牛山銅器，鱘，鮓。

translations.literal: Local tribute: gauze robes, damasks of water-pattern, square-pattern, fish-mouth, embroidered-leaf, and floral designs, fire-hemp cloth, bamboo root and yellow millet, copper ware from Mount Funiu, sturgeon, and pickled fish.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included gauze robes; damasks in water, square, fish-mouth, embroidered-leaf, and floral patterns; fire-hemp cloth; bamboo root and yellow millet; copper ware from Mount Funiu; sturgeon; and pickled fish.

sentences.zh: 戶十萬二千二十三，口六十六萬二千七百六。

translations.literal: Households: one hundred two thousand twenty-three; persons: six hundred sixty-two thousand seven hundred six.

Dantu, Danyang, Jintan, Yanling.
translations.idiomatic: Dantu, Danyang, Jintan, and Yanling counties.

translations.literal: Sheng Prefecture—Sheng Prefecture: Jiangning commandery; in the second year of Zhide it was established from Jiangning County in Run Prefecture; abolished in the second year of Shangyuan; in the third year of Guangqi it was re-established from the four counties of Shangyuan, Jurong, Lishui, and Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Prefecture, Jiangning commandery. Created in Zhide 2 from Jiangning in Run Prefecture, abolished in Shangyuan 2, then restored in Guangqi 3 from Shangyuan, Jurong, Lishui, and Liyang counties.

translations.literal: Local tribute: brushes and sweet crabapple.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included writing brushes and sweet crabapple.

translations.literal: Four counties.
Shangyuan, Jurong, Lishui, Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shangyuan, Jurong, Lishui, and Liyang counties.

translations.literal: Chang Prefecture—Chang Prefecture: Jinling commandery, illustrious grade.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Prefecture, Jinling commandery, illustrious grade.

sentences.zh: 本毗陵郡，天寶元年更名。

translations.literal: Originally Piling commandery; in the first year of Tianbao the name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Piling commandery; renamed in Tianbao 1.

sentences.zh: 土貢：紬、絹、布、紵、紅紫綿巾、緊紗、兔褐、皂布、大小香秔、龍鳳席、紫筍茶、署預。
